assurance_boundary: Static template collection only. Product data is fictional/local; no real AI, app blocking, accounts, purchases or message sending. Desktop Chrome plus viewport and reduced-motion emulation; no physical Safari or VoiceOver certification. Readiness applies to this static template collection, not the fictional products shown. Active-agent self-review only; no independent-agent System certification.
